feeds.title: Synthtopia
feeds.description: Follow this blog for synthesizer and electronic music news, synth and music software reviews and more! Synthtopia is a portal devoted to electronic music. Synthtopia covers all types of electronic music, serious, popular, even seriously popular. There's a lot of great electronic music coming from all types of composers and musicians. You'll find that we include hardcore electronica along with pop electronica, and dark ambient music along with chillout.

feeds.title: MATRIXSYNTH
feeds.description: Synthesizer website is dedicated to everything synth, eurorack, modular, electronic music, and more.

feeds.title: GreatSynthesizers
feeds.description: Great Synthesizers is an online magazine with reviews, pictures, documents and soundfiles of analogue and digital synthesizers & related music gear. Their aim is to provide an archive of synthesizer reviews and audiofiles to which everyone has access, to exchange experiences and form networks.

feeds.title: MuseWire
feeds.description: Music Industry Newswire (MuseWire) covers music makers, music gear, reviews, the music business and related topics; established 2004. MuseWire is a publication of Neotrope, a company specializing in PR, design, advertising and more.

feeds.title: Synth Anatomy
feeds.description: Synth Anatomy is a music technology website based in Vienna (Austria) which has its focus mainly on hardware and software which are strongly related to electronic music production. Their aim is to inform musicians about the new available music technologies. Follow this blog for synthesizer news, reviews, videos, music trade shows, published tutorials, interview musicians & developers, drum machines, music software and more.

feeds.title: Gearnews
feeds.description: Gearnews is the go-to blog with red-hot, up-to-the-second news for musicians. The latest equipment news & rumors for synths, recording and synthesizer.

feeds.title: Intellijel
feeds.description: Intellijel is a creator of electronic musical instruments and modular synthesizers. Follow this blog to find all things related to Intellijel products, tips, suggestions, etc.

feeds.title: Pittsburgh Modular Synthesizers
feeds.description: We are Pittsburgh Modular Synthesizers and we make electronic instruments for musicians and sonic architects. Our innovative designs promote unrestricted, interactive synthesis for maximum control of maximum sound. Follow this blog for product related news.

feeds.title: Mark Mosher Blog
feeds.description: A synth tech, technique and travelogue blog by synthesist Mark Mosher. He is a composer, producer, electronic musician, and multimedia artist from Boulder, CO. He releases and performs cinematic electronic, experimental, dark ambient, dark techno, musique concrète, and glitch music.

feeds.title: JonDent
feeds.description: A blog about Explorations in Electronic Music, Art & Travel (but mostly electronic music). Here you will find information about vintage & modern synths, electronic music, DJing & production.

feeds.title: Horizontalpitch
feeds.description: A blogzine about modular synthesizers, music experiments and life without presets. Here you will find in-depth articles about trends and developments on the eurorack scene and market, inspiring music examples, tips and howtos and occasionally some news.

feeds.title: Synthpoplover
feeds.description: Synthpoplover promotes synthesizer/synth music and electronic pop music. They promote signed and unsigned bands that make electronic vs pop music.

feeds.title: Synth Evolution Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find Illustrations of every synthesizer from the 1960s to the late 80's all available in a mug (or three) of your choice.

feeds.title: Retro Synth Ads
feeds.description: Growing up, synthesizer advertisements were the only way for me to find out about new synths. I loved drooling at the gear advertised in magazines such as Keyboard and Electronic Musician.

feeds.title: PatchPierre.Net
feeds.description: PatchPierre is a site dedicated to analog modular synthesis, and especially his own Doepfer A-100 Analog Modular Synthesizer. Here you will find post on 100 -tips, -patches, sound-examples and other general (analog) synthesizer-tips.

feeds.title: Synth History
feeds.description: Synth History is dedicated to retro / vintage synths, drum machines, and the musicians who used them.

feeds.title: Synth and Software
feeds.description: Synth & Software is an online publication and social media community for electronic music enthusiasts - anyone who enjoys listening or who plays, programs, or aspires to make music with synthesizers, samplers, DAWs, audio processors, and other instruments and software - or as we like to call them, synthusiasts.We deliver the most accurate information, the timeliest tips, the most comprehensive free lessons, the most revealing interviews, and the most authoritative reviews we could possibly offer.

feeds.title: Richard Brewster's Electronic Sounds
feeds.description: Richard Brewster DIY modular synthesis and experimental electronic music, including MOTM, Ciat-Lonbarde, Catgirl Synth, Mattson, Oakley, Wiard-Blacet, BugBrand, and more. The name Pugix (and the graphic toon) belonged to an online gaming character that I used to play and have nothing to do with synthesizers.

feeds.title: CatSynth
feeds.description: Explore articles about music, cats, art, culture, or whatever else we feel like talking about, find demos and tutorials on synthesizers, reviews and analysis of film, music, and books, and variety of other content that sometimes suprises.

feeds.title: The Bob Moog Foundation News
feeds.description: Be first to know about our biannual Minimoog raffle, and be part of our work sharing Bob's legacy and inspiring the future with the science of sound. We are bringing Bob Moog's pioneering legacy alive through immersive, interactive exhibits that bring to light the history, science, and art of his remarkable career.

feeds.title: AMSynths Blog
feeds.description: AMSynths is an innovative synthesizer manufacturing company, owned and design led by me- Rob Keeble. I am an electronics engineer (trained at University of Essex), electronic musician and retired IT professional. I regularly blog about vintage synthesizers and samplers, the technology used and their restoration.

feeds.title: Attack Magazine » Synth Secrets
feeds.description: Attack Magazine's Synth Secrets is a series of programming tutorials in which we show how to make a range of classic and new synth sounds. Learn and master the basic as well as some innovative advanced techniques from the art of synthesizing. Attack Magazine is an electronic music online magazine and store dedicated to dance music production.

feeds.title: MusicRadar » Synths Coverage
feeds.description: Browse this page for all the latest keyboard and synth news, reviews and tips on MusicRadar. Stay tuned for the latest MusicRadar news, reviews, interviews and more. MusicRadar is the world's number 1 website for music makers of all kinds, helping musicians find the best gear and providing them guidance from recognised musicians and stars.

feeds.title: Vintage Synth Explorer
feeds.description: The Vintage Synth Explorer was established back in 1996 in order to provide a fast and easy way to learn about vintage synthesizers. This has grown to include modern digital and analog emulators, software synths, plug-ins, and other new types of synthesizers and samplers. Here you will find detailed descriptions and reviews, pictures, audio and video samples, technical specifications, lists of famous users, links and more in our library of over 750 electronic instruments!

feeds.title: Sequential
feeds.description: Sequential is led by legendary instrument designer and Grammy-winner Dave Smith, the founder of Sequential Circuits in 1974. In 1977 Dave designed the Prophet-5, the world's first fully-programmable polyphonic synth, and the first musical instrument with an embedded microprocessor. Sequential released many innovative instruments and drum machines over the next 10 years. Check out the section to get updates on product development, features, and instructional videos!

feeds.title: Synthrotek
feeds.description: Synthrotek is an electronic circuit design business specializing in lofi, DIY and Analog noise making and synth kits. Here you will find resources for making great Modular, console and other electronic kits for the electronic musician.

feeds.title: Euterpe Synthesizer Laboratories
feeds.description: At Euterpe Synthesizer Laboratories (ESL), we design and build analog synthesizers with each of their own audio grade components, wooden side panels, circuit boards and structural base frames (chassis).

feeds.title: Synth&Sequences
feeds.description: This webzine is completely dedicated to Electronic Music (EM) identified as the Berlin School style and its derived. You will find interviews but mostly reviews of ambient, sequenced and symphonic EM with a glimpse on other related genres.

feeds.title: Raspberry Pi Synthesizer
feeds.description: This blog is authored by Phil Atkin who makes beautiful music softwares.

feeds.title: The Synth and I
feeds.description: Legion is a human obsessed with aural synthesis and sound and the tools available to better understand his world. Get insights on obsessions and excursions into synthesis, sound, art, and inspiration.

feeds.title: Synth Wizards Blog
feeds.description: Syntaur was originally an electronic rock band in the 1980s, for which Sam Mims was a keyboardist and vocalist. Syntaur sells new and refurbished vintage synthesizers and is the leading provider of keyboard parts on the planet. Explore our blog as we mod synthesizers to make unbelievable one-of-a-kind synths.

feeds.title: Gearjunkies » Synthesizers
feeds.description: Don't miss the latest news and reviews about electronic music production gear and artists, synthesizers, studio equipment, plug-ins, DJ and MIDI controllers. feeds.title: Loopop
feeds.description: I do enjoy digging deep into what a piece of electronic music gear can do - and learning by having someone show you is the best way to do that, especially considering cryptic manuals some manufacturers create. This blog is all about electronic music gear reviews, ideas, tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Synthesizerwriter Blog
feeds.description: Know more about various synthesizers with pictures, music, tips and more!

feeds.title: SOUND7

Read about which synths to buy and which to avoid. SOUND7 is a team of Specialists in Sound Design, Synth plugins, and Music Production Resources.

feeds.title: Growing your modular synthesizer for dummies
feeds.description: Peregrinations of JF Lucas, an apprentice electronic DIYer. This blog documents his journey - that of a hobbyist into the world of DIY synthesizers. Read in-depth and insightful accounts of Soun experimentation, Synthesizer equipment reviews, and many other topics.

feeds.title: Synth.nl Blog
feeds.description: My Name is Michel van Osenbruggen and I produce synthesizer music under the name Synth.nl. This titular blog is about my music, my studio, and my DIY projects. Here you can find assorted categories - My projects on Synth music, Synth News, my personal views and other updates.

feeds.title: Synths When Blog
feeds.description: Check out our latest blogs to find updates on the shop, our work, our partners, and synth repair in general. Synths When is a vintage synthesizer repair shop located in downtown Toronto, Canada servicing everything from repairing and rebuilding to tuning and regular maintenance.

feeds.title: 8Sided Blog » Synthesizers
feeds.description: Browse all articles from 8sided tagged Synthesizers. 8sided.blog is a digital magazine about sound, culture, and Punk Rock. Author Michael Donaldson gets candid about a bunch of topics including the changing Music Industry, Music Technology, and Synthesizers.

feeds.title: Engadget » synthesizer
feeds.description: Get the latest synthesizer info from our tech-obsessed editors with breaking news, in-depth reviews, hands-on videos, and our insights on future products. Engadget is a web magazine with obsessive daily coverage of everything new in gadgets and consumer electronics.

feeds.title: Synthfind
feeds.description: Celebrating and tracking down classic synths. All posts presented here are for informative, historical and educative purposes, Indexing vintage and interesting analog and digital synthesizers.

feeds.title: Sequencer.de Blog
feeds.description: This blog is all about news, information and updates about sequencers, synths & DAWs.

feeds.title: Thonk
feeds.description: Thonk Ltd is here to bring you modular synthesiser DIY kits and accessories.

feeds.title: FluidSynth
feeds.description: FluidSynth is a real-time software synthesizer based on the SoundFont 2 specifications and has reached widespread distribution. FluidSynth itself does not have a graphical user interface, but due to its powerful API several applications utilize it and it has even found its way onto embedded systems and is used in some mobile apps. Follow this blog for lots of friendly help and information about all aspects of the Miditzer and theatre organs in general.

feeds.title: Synthmorph Blog
feeds.description: Synthmorph sound sets for synthesizers are the symbiosis of unique MIDI sequences and related synth presets with matching parameter set constituting a morphing, expressive sound together. Follow this blog for more information and also listen to examples about the Synthmorph concept here.

feeds.title: StromKult

feeds.title: Synth replicants Blog
